candidates.snippet: -1792: Ascension to the throne - Became king of Babylon, initiating his reign and subsequent expansion of the Babylonian empire. -1763: Conquest of Larsa - Defeated the city-state of Larsa, a significant step in consolidating his control over Mesopotamia. -1754: Issuance of Hammurabi's Code - Promulgated his famous legal code, establishing standardized laws and punishments throughout his empire. -1750: Death of Hammurabi - The death of Hammurabi marked the end of his long and influential reign over the Babylonian empire.
